decision.summary: Two multi-axis offset candidates identified within screened region: (1) E/U drop at 460–480 with sustained N trend; (2) E/U rise at 510–525, also superposed on N trend. In both cases, onset and interior are coherent across axes, but returns are unobserved or ambiguous within allowed context [385,579], preventing confirmation. No isolated spikes or permanent steps dominate; motion remains largely trend-dominated with transient cross-axis perturbations.

intervals.observation: E drops ~1.5 MAD and U drops ~2 MAD between indices 460–480, while N continues its sustained upward trend; the multi-axis offset is coherent and distinct from the background trend, but the return is not clearly observed within allowed context (ends at 480, next samples show continued N rise without reversal), so status is uncertain

E rises ~1 MAD and U rises ~1.5 MAD between indices 510–525, superposed on ongoing N trend; interior shows coherent offset shape, but no clear opposing return before index 579 (allowed end), and subsequent N continues rising—return ambiguous, status uncertain
